item.title: The Rise of the Agentic Browser: What Every CISO Must Know
item.description:
Author: Sanjay Krishnan
Date: 2023-07-20
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Artificial Intelligence", "Web Technology", "Privacy", "User Experience"]
Summary:
  • Browsers now integrate AI agents to assist users.
  • Agentic browsers act as autonomous assistants.
  • They manage tasks and interact with web services.
  • Key features include context awareness and proactive help.
  • Privacy and security are major concerns.
  • These browsers will change internet interaction significantly.
